s.en: The Hand and Eye of Vecna have come together again, and Kas, who once betrayed and wounded Vecna, has sensed it. He comes with the Sword of Kas and a band of followers to destroy (or seize) the artifacts.\n\nThe Sword of Kas deals double damage to hosts of Vecna's artifacts. Defeat Kas to get the sword.
